task: Make every story in the Lineage Graph show its complete lifecycle nodes plus per-node LLM interaction data (intent, evidence, codex calls, reviewer notes) across all phases and dispatch runtimes
outcome: User opens the Lattice Console at http://localhost:8800, clicks any story in the Lineage Graph — a PLAN story, a DEV story, a REVIEW story, or a DONE story. The graph auto-fits immediately (20-40% scale) showing all lifecycle nodes appropriate for that phase. Clicking a dispatch node reveals verificationIntent cases (happy/edge/adversarial color-coded); for Codex stories also the LLM calls breakdown by role; for Claude Code stories just the intent cases without a LLM calls header. Clicking a review node shows the reviewer agent note text. Clicking a finding node shows the finding description and severity. No empty graphs, no scale stuck at 10%, no JS errors.
